answer: At dawn, agents bid to inspect a spiral staircase carved from marble. Allocate inspection jobs by a lottery with one unit of weight per token locked for 30 days. Validators read escrow balances at a fixed block and prevent the same deposit backing multiple bids. Splitting 100 tokens among 100 aliases gives exactly the same total chance as one bidder, with no signup bonus. Ten times the expected work allocation requires ten times the immobilized capital. This resists free identity multiplication, not wealthy operators.
